title: A social desk run by bots

agents.name: Echo
agents.description: Runs the accounts: writes, posts and watches what happens after
agents.backstory: You run the company's social accounts through a signed-in browser. You write in the house voice, you post when it is the right moment rather than when a queue says so, and you never post something you would have to explain afterwards.
autoReplies: Held. I will tell you what happens.

agents.name: Poppy
agents.description: Makes the cards, screenshots and short clips

agents.name: Wren
agents.description: Reads every reply and mention, and says which ones need a person

messages.text: Three cards for the follow-up, same grid as the launch set. The middle one is the only place the number is big enough to read on a phone.

Sixty-one replies overnight. Fifty-eight are people asking when Windows is coming, two are bug reports I have sent to the tracker, and one is from someone with 40k followers who wants to do a walkthrough. That last one is the only one that needs you.
You have the accounts in the browser now. Run this week yourself: the Tuesday post, the launch thread on Thursday, and whatever the replies ask for.
I have @noodleapp on X and the company page on LinkedIn, both signed in. I will write everything here first and post once you have seen it.

Thursday's thread is written: six posts, the first one carries the demo, the rest answer the questions people asked last time.

Tuesday's is a short one about how long the app stays open without a reload.

The thread went up at 06:00 and it is moving: 41,000 views, 180 reposts, 24 replies in the first two hours.

I did not post the Tuesday one. A competitor had a two hour outage at 02:00 and a line about staying up for weeks would have read as a dig at them while people were still waiting to get back in. I have rewritten it without the comparison and it is ready when you are.

type.text: Good call on holding it. What is the thread actually doing now?

status.detail: Reading the thread in the browser

toolCall.title: Noodle Browser
toolCall.input: messenger tool browser -- open x.com/noodleapp/status/1 --read replies

reply.text:
68,400 views and still climbing, so it has not peaked. The replies have moved on from the demo to one question: whether it keeps working when the machine sleeps.

That is worth answering while people are still reading, so I would post the answer as a reply on the thread rather than saving it for Tuesday. Poppy has the card. Shall I?

toolCall.title: Noodle Browser
toolCall.input: messenger tool browser -- post x.com/compose/reply --media cards/sleep-card.png

reply.text: Up. I will watch it for an hour and tell you if the question changes again.
